summary: As we All gather this Solstice season The Three Children of Abraham dancing with Brahma and Vishnu knowing Shiva will have the mic drop. Let's let fate's feet erase our future on a stage carved of Mandalas carried away on a Turtle's Shell. For I am we, each grain in wind at your back Happy Holidays to All #BabbyBobby #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
As we All gather this
Solstice season
The Three Children
of Abraham
dancing with Brahma
and Vishnu
knowing Shiva will
have the mic drop.
Let's let fate's
feet erase our future
on a stage carved
of
Mandalas
carried away on a
Turtle's Shell.
For I am we,
each grain
in wind at
your back

Happy Holidays to All

#BabbyBobby
#smallpoems
